##Vitaparcours Olten 1

```{r}
library("readr")

Vita <- read_delim("datasets/Vita_1/track_points.csv", ",")



library(sf)

Vita_sf <- st_as_sf(
  Vita,
  coords = c("X", "Y"),
  crs = 2056, remove = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(Vita_sf)+
  geom_sf()+
  geom_path(aes(X,Y))
  

```



```{r}

library(dplyr)
distance_by_element <- function(later, now) {
  as.numeric(
    st_distance(later, now, by_element = TRUE)
  )
}




route <- Vita_resampled |>
    mutate(
        nMinus2 = distance_by_element(lag(geometry, 10), geometry), 
        nMinus1 = distance_by_element(lag(geometry, 5), geometry), 
        nPlus1  = distance_by_element(geometry, lead(geometry, 5)), 
        nPlus2  = distance_by_element(geometry, lead(geometry, 10)))


route <- route |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
        stepMean = mean(c(nMinus2, nMinus1, nPlus1, nPlus2), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ungroup()

```





```{r}

threshold <- mean(route$stepMean, na.rm = TRUE)


route <- route |>
    mutate(move = stepMean > threshold)


ggplot(route)+
  geom_sf(aes(color=move))


route_static <- route |>
    filter(!move)

ggplot(route_static)+
  geom_sf(aes(color=move))

```



```{r}
rle_id <- function(vec) {
    x <- rle(vec)$lengths
    as.factor(rep(seq_along(x), times = x))
}

route_id <- route |>
    mutate(segment_id = rle_id(move))

```



```{r}


library(tmap)
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(route_static) + 
  tm_dots()

tmap_options(basemap.server = "OpenStreetMap")



```
